hq-operations-137: What is a franchise HQ operations management system?
hq-operations-138: It's a system that manages franchise inquiries, consultations, contracts, opening prep, store operations and HQ–store communication as a single data flow. FDAM is MS Venter's franchisor ERP that manages this entire flow in one system.
hq-operations-139: How is FDAM different from managing with Excel and messengers?
hq-operations-140: In Excel and messengers, sales, contract, opening and inspection records scatter across individuals and the history breaks. FDAM gathers these records into a single per-store history and connects sales and operating data, so AI can suggest which stores to check and what to do next.
hq-operations-141: Can it reflect our brand's own processes?
hq-operations-142: Yes. FDAM configures its structure—sales stages, opening checklists, inspection items and more—around your brand's actual processes. We'll confirm the exact scope when you talk to sales.
hq-operations-143: How do we track store opening progress?
hq-operations-144: FDAM shows each store's schedule, owners, department checklists, required documents and completion status on one screen, so you can manage delayed items.
hq-operations-145: Can we migrate our existing data?
hq-operations-146: When you adopt FDAM, we review the format and quality of your current data, then decide the migration scope and method. Excel files or data from existing systems may require field mapping.
hq-operations-147: How are HQ and store permissions separated?
hq-operations-148: FDAM can define what each role can view and do—HQ admins, department staff, supervisors, store owners and employees. Store-side work connects through Sodam.
